dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You just said you wanted to write a classic romance story...

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: *cough* I—Isn't that very normal? After all, romance and love have been a theatrical theme since time immemorial! I didn't mean anything else, really!

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: As my ancestor... Master Coppelius once said...!

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: "There is no absolute good or evil, only absolute beauty and ugliness. And that which makes beauty is eternal love..."

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: Whether it be the chronicle of Chariclea or the legend of the Lochknights, these are all romantic classics...

dialogues.speaker: Goldoni
dialogues.text: Wh—Whatever the case, don't misunderstand, you hear?
